curated-boska-gf-nobile: Chiseled drama up top, tidy modern text below. Boska is best at fat stems and wiry hairlines, while Nobile, a low-slung plain sans, handles quieter lines, say, in an email newsletter.
curated-boska-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Stone-carved drama meets a quiet modern text face. Boska swings from stout stems to slender hairlines, while Noto Sans Elbasan stays low in contrast with large lowercase forms and terminals left open.
curated-boska-gf-red-hat-text: Sharp, scratchy glamour over rounded, friendly text. Boska slams thick strokes against thin ones, while Red Hat Text keeps a curvy, constant-width line you could trace with a finger.
curated-boska-gf-roboto: Roboto brings tall, friendly lowercase with generous round mouths. Boska's thick stems and thin crossbars give the pair its drama, with Roboto's taller lowercase holding steady (an interior design moodboard, say).
curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Blocky terminal-screen charm meets smooth modern curves. Pixel Operator locks fixed-width letters into solid blocks, while Work Sans keeps its curves full to the shoulder, say, for settings toggles.
curated-dafont-redux-gf-graduate: Graduate spreads dignified, bookish letters with generous white between them. Line after line its stroke never changes weight, so the text moves at an unhurried pace, far from Redux's wide, entrance-heavy curves.
curated-dafont-whitin-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP is literary and refined, with an unclenched c. Whitin suits big moments, say, an art fair booth banner, since its hairlines vanish when shrunk and it isn't built for lengthy text.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Holtwood One SC stands tall and wide-tracked, its curves nearly closed (a cannabis dispensary logo, say). And line after line it would read loud and weighty, with New Title's locked-together letters adding to the pull.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-lexend-tera: New Title locks its letters together like links in a chain. Lexend Tera, a sans-serif drawn with plotter-pen lines, spaces its rounded letters far apart, loosening up what the heading ties tight.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-major-mono-displ: Major Mono Display glows like neon tubing, precise and technical. Its monospace letters, spaced wide, would march across lines at a slow, deliberate pace, while New Title stays tall and tightly linked.
